title: Intermittent name resolution failures
query: A few checkouts randomly fail because orders can't look up the payments hostname. Payments itself has stayed up the whole time, so what's going on?
root_cause: Intermittent name resolution failure between orders and payments.

remediation.detail: Fix the DNS resolver configuration and restart the resolver.

evidence: Orders logs show intermittent name resolution failures for payments
Payments is up and its own error ratio is zero
Failures are intermittent and not tied to a deploy
